title: Urysohn cutoff with small measure halo: ψ = 1 on a compact C, tsupport ψ ⊆ W, μ(support ψ ∖ C) < ε
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P and μ a measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Let C ⊆ ℝ^P be compact and W ⊆ U open with C ⊆ W, and let ε ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is a continuous ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support, tsupport ψ ⊆ W, 0 ≤ ψ(x) ≤ 1 for all x, ψ = 1 on C, and μ(support ψ ∖ C) < ε.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → ∀ C W : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact C → IsOpen W → C ⊆ W → W ⊆ U → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, ε ≠ 0 → ∃ ψ : Eucl P → ℝ, Continuous ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ W ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x ∧ ψ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ C, ψ x = 1) ∧ μ (Function.support ψ \ C) < ε
